title: BUILT FOR SPORT.
DESIGNED FOR
MANAGEMENT.
demo.label: THE SYSTEM BEHIND EVERY SESSION
lines: Every great session starts before the first whistle.
But scattered schedules, payment follow-ups and missing member details can pull your attention away from coaching.
Meet Courvix.

title: TWO PRODUCTS.
YOUR WAY
TO WORK.
demo.label: CHOOSE YOUR WORKFLOW
lines: One brand. Two focused products.
Club Management organizes members, teams and recurring dues.
Personal Training connects clients, appointments and paid session packs.
Choose the workflow that fits your business.

title: START WITH
THE RIGHT
FOUNDATION.
demo.label: YOUR BUSINESS / YOUR WORKSPACE
lines: Set up your workspace with your sport, location, currency and time zone.
Review your subscription in Billing. Submitted payments need verification before approval.
Then build the structure your staff will work in.

title: YOUR CLUB.
THE FULL
PICTURE.
demo.label: CLUB MANAGEMENT / CONTROL ROOM
lines: Open the Club control room for the full operational picture.
See your roster, teams, coaches, upcoming training and payment reviews together.
The attention queue helps you find the records that need a next step.

title: ONE MEMBER.
EVERY
CONNECTION.
demo.label: MEMBER 360 / CONNECTED RECORDS
lines: Choose a member to open their complete overview.
Their profile, team, coach, schedule, attendance and payment records stay connected on one page.
Open a source record to inspect or update the detail, with your existing permissions.

title: BRING YOUR
PEOPLE
TOGETHER.
demo.label: INVITE / ACCEPT / GET TO WORK
lines: Invite an administrator, coach, member or client using the email they use for ChatGPT.
They accept the single-use invitation and complete their profile.
Each role gets its own view. Coaches and clients do not receive administrator financial access.

title: LESS CHASING.
CLEARER
FOLLOW-UP.
demo.label: CLUB DUES / PAYMENT REVIEW
lines: Track recurring dues and review payment submissions against your actual receipts.
An administrator records verification; Courvix does not automatically settle bank transfers.
Configured reminders follow unpaid balances and stop after payment or a declined renewal.

title: SELL THE
WAY YOU
COACH.
demo.label: PERSONAL TRAINING / OFFERS
lines: For Personal Training, create an offer for a single visit, or a pack of four, eight or sixteen sessions.
Set the price, expiry and booking policies clearly, so clients know what they are buying before they pay.

title: PAID.
RESERVED.
COMPLETED.
demo.label: PERSONAL TRAINING / SESSION CREDITS
lines: The client submits their payment reference. You verify the receipt to activate the pack.
Booking reserves one available credit.
Completing the session uses that credit once.
Purchased, available, reserved and used sessions stay visible, so the next booking starts with a clear balance.

title: THE RIGHT
SESSION.
THE RIGHT TIME.
demo.label: APPOINTMENTS / CLASSES / CAPACITY
lines: Manage one-to-one appointments and shared classes with assigned trainers, session times and class capacity.
Confirm requests, check availability and keep booking conflicts out of the schedule.
Cancellations and no-shows follow the terms attached to the booking.

title: EVERY CLIENT.
EVERY
NEXT STEP.
demo.label: PERSONAL TRAINING / CLIENT 360
lines: After training, record the outcome and progress.
The Training control room brings each client's goals, appointments, packs, balances and progress together.
Use that context to plan the next session, instead of rebuilding the story from separate tabs.

title: LOCAL DETAIL.
A WIDER
PERSPECTIVE.
demo.label: MULTIPLE WORKSPACES / CLEAR OVERSIGHT
lines: Managing more than one club location or training workspace? Use the network view for oversight, then switch into the location you need.
Keep local records and role access clear as your operation grows.

title: MORE TIME
FOR THE
NEXT SESSION.
demo.label: YOUR SPORT / YOUR PEOPLE / COURVIX
lines: Your people. Your progress. The work behind every session, connected.
Explore the interactive demo as an owner, coach or member.
Choose Club Management or Personal Training, and find your workflow with Courvix.
